cues.narration: Light striking the photocathode releases an electron.
cues.visual: A photon reaches the photocathode and releases one electron.

cues.narration: A high voltage applied between successive electrodes
cues.visual: The voltage difference and successive dynodes are highlighted.

cues.narration: accelerates the electron toward the next electrode,
cues.visual: The first electron accelerates toward the first dynode.

cues.narration: multiplying the number of electrons at every stage.
cues.visual: Electrons multiply in dense, individually distinguishable bunches.

cues.narration: The resulting electrical signal can be amplified by a million to a hundred million times.
cues.visual: Charge collects at the anode, followed by a gain indication and an output pulse.

timing: Editorial cue timings retained from the original animation; English narration is a translation and is not aligned to a recorded voice.
